It then uses the domain parser parseTaskStatus to turn the input into a status filter, queries the TaskRepository port, and maps the results to application DTOs. All of this is application work. The file has no persistence code (no SQL, ORM or DB client), no transport or framework handling (no HTTP request/response objects or status codes) and no invented business invariants, since status parsing is handed off to the domain value object. ExecuteContextDto is a plain application-level context DTO with an optional requestId. It is not tied to any transport and is not used for transport behaviour.
